known_overlap: Target 1379072 appears in both the local fixed-inequality window and the selected strict-closure window.
The 12x25 neutral selector holdout includes the earlier 6x25 neutral selector grid.
interpretation: The current record is not a large broad sample. It combines narrow stress fixtures, which are useful for locating theorem obligations, with finite selector-denominator scans, which have not yet produced broad active rows to stress.
next_non_circular_test: Predeclare additional selector-denominator holdouts on new windows, or run the expensive strict-closure stress pass only when an unchanged selector produces active rows; keep scanned/selected/applicable/stressed counts separate and do not change constants midstream.
do_not_count_as_evidence: An attempted 12-window by 25-target strict-closure probe on starts 1000000 + 10010*k for k=0..11 was interrupted after more than seven minutes with no receipt. It is a performance finding only, not mathematical evidence.
